comment: Paths a code factory work order may never touch, whatever any gate says (homelab-2nd agents/factory/CONTRACT.md point 5, GUL-2238). The engine reads this file from the pull request's base commit. Only the owner merges a change to these paths. Dockerfile and entrypoint.sh define the image that runs in production; backend/migrations change the live Postgres schema on the next release; tokens.py, ingest_auth.py and sou_mode.py hold the ingest-token checks and the public read-only mode.
